title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
summary: This document troubleshoots unexpected Hunter Green fees: a $25.00 monthly maintenance fee (waived if period-end balance meets $5,000), $15.00 outgoing domestic wire fees, $2.00 per transaction for domestic out-of-network U.S. ATM use, and foreign ATM fees of 2.5% (minimum $4.00) plus possible ATM-operator surcharges. It explains how to confirm calculations and what evidence to submit for fee reviews, and notes that certain fees may include carbon-offset allocations without increasing published amounts.
faqs: Why was I charged the Hunter Green $25.00 monthly maintenance fee?
How can I tell if my balance met the $5,000 waiver threshold for the statement period?
What triggers the $15.00 outgoing domestic wire fee, and how do I check if it’s duplicative?
How are domestic out-of-network ATM fees calculated (including the $2.00 per transaction)?
What is the foreign ATM fee formula (2.5% with a $4.00 minimum) and how do I verify the settled amount?
What should I submit to request a review of an incorrect fee (statement period, balance, wire/ATM details, receipts)?
keywords: Domestic out-of-network ATM fee ($2.00 per transaction)
Requesting a fee review (statement period, balance, wire date/reference, ATM receipt)
